executiveSummary: Kelly Grappe's Experience-to-Office Alignment Profile maps three decades of organizational leadership, training-systems work, rural civic education, and community stewardship to the actual duties of Arkansas Secretary of State — election administration across seventy-five counties, business and commercial filings, public records transparency, Capitol stewardship, civic education, and large-scale cross-division management. This dossier is written for Kelly to read before debate and clerk rooms: not a résumé recitation guide, but a narrative bridge from lived experience to SOS service philosophy. Every section includes plain-English walkthroughs, debate framing examples, and drill-down links to coaching, claims, and opponent contrast modules.
